regime.label: Hawkish-hike overhang, relief rally
regime.oneLiner: A hotter-than-expected core CPI pushed Fed hike odds to ~87-90% for Wednesday's FOMC, yet Friday's equity rally and VIX collapse show markets treating the hike as fully priced rather than a fresh shock -- a fragile relief rally, not a resolved regime.

topNews.headline: August CPI matches headline consensus but core runs hot; Sep 16 Fed hike odds jump to ~87-90%
topNews.actionable: A confirmed Fed hike into a war-inflation shock (rather than the cut the market spent most of 2026 pricing) is a genuine headwind for the levered silver/miners sleeve and SGX bank/REIT valuations via higher real yields -- size positions assuming Wednesday delivers the hike, not a surprise hold.

topNews.headline: FOMC meets Sep 15-16; a 25bp hike to 3.75-4.00% is now the base case, not a cut
topNews.actionable: This is the single biggest scheduled catalyst for the whole book next week -- the real surprise risk is a hold (not a hike), which would likely spark an outsized relief rally in miners and S-REITs alike given how heavily a hike is already priced.

topNews.headline: Gold and silver whipsaw through the CPI print, close near $4,385-4,389 and ~$65 despite 90% hike odds
topNews.actionable: Metals shrugging off a near-90%-priced hike is a constructive tell, but the scale of the intraday whipsaw (silver -2.6% before recovering) means Monday's open can gap either way -- avoid adding leverage to the miners sleeve until Wednesday's FOMC outcome is confirmed.

topNews.headline: S&P snaps four-day losing streak (+0.86% to 7,657) as VIX collapses ~11-12% to ~15.6-15.8
topNews.actionable: The vol collapse is a genuine short-term relief signal for risk assets, but it coexists with a near-90%-priced hike -- an unusual pairing that argues for using this calm to review hedges on the large cash pile rather than chasing the rally into next week's FOMC.

topNews.headline: Largest wave yet of US-Iran tanker strikes near the Strait of Hormuz; oil pushed above $108-109 before Friday's pullback
topNews.actionable: This remains a worsening, not fading, conflict with no ceasefire in sight -- keep the oil/energy exposure and cash pile in place as hedges, and treat Friday's oil pullback as profit-taking/relief rather than a signal the Hormuz risk has passed.
